title: 11 countries contest medals at U19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championships
summary: Eleven countries from Asia will be in action in the inaugural ASTAF U19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championships, which opens on Thursday at the Rizal Memorial Coliseum.
